title: Center Fuselage Structure
summary: Primary load-bearing structural core connecting the wings, engine intakes, internal fuel tanks, and internal weapons bays.
role: Carries wing-box bending loads, houses S-shaped engine ducts and weapons bays, and anchors the disassembled view.
materials: Heavy titanium alloy bulkheads (~39% airframe Ti share) with composite fuselage skins.
